summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K reporting the adoption of a preferred stock rights agreement (poison pill) and declaration of a dividend of one right per share of common stock, effective July 1, 2026. The rights become exercisable if a person or group acquires beneficial ownership of 10% or more of common stock without board approval, triggering significant dilution. Each right entitles the holder to purchase one one-thousandth of a share of Series D Junior Participating Preferred Stock at $3.75. This is a defensive shareholder rights plan, not a fundamental corporate transaction. No deal terms apply. Watch for any activist accumulation or board response.
